Grade 4 under the named CTCAE term: life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

after.term: Grade documented for the previous febrile-neutropenia episode
after.guidance: Review the previous episode record, including contemporaneous neutrophils, temperature, clinical severity and the grading system used. Table 4 distinguishes grade 4 from consideration for grade 3, and later recurrence despite G-CSF. Current febrile neutropenia or suspected sepsis belongs in the separate urgent current-event field; current normal counts do not erase prior history. The source addresses prior grades 3 and 4 only. Leave an unclassified episode unresolved and obtain clinical-record review; do not map unsupported or unknown historical severity to no previous episode.
